appliedUpdates.description: Added OpenTUI ScrollBox API pattern to architecture.md — documents correct typed ref usage (ScrollBoxRenderable) and scrollBy vs scrollTo, preventing future workers from using any-typed refs

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a 'verification-only feature' workflow variant to the tui-worker skill. When a feature is purely about writing tests for already-implemented functionality, skip the RED-GREEN TDD cycle and go straight to test authoring. The current procedure assumes every feature has an implementation phase.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature dynamic-insertion-display was a pure test-writing task. Worker deviated from skill steps 3-4 (RED/GREEN TDD) because all underlying code was already implemented by prior features. Worker's skillFeedback.suggestedChanges noted: 'Consider adjusting feature descriptions to reflect when prior features have already implemented the underlying functionality.'

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention for adapter testing: adapter tests should instantiate the actual adapter class (OpenTUIAdapter/HeadlessAdapter) with mock UIActions and verify handleEvent() delegates correctly. Tests that call store actions directly are store tests, not adapter tests. Label them accordingly.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature dynamic-insertion-display: tests/dynamic-insertion-display.test.ts lines 197-249 has a describe block named 'adapter event handling for dynamic insertion' but tests store.insertQueueStep/removeQueueStep directly without instantiating any adapter. This pattern could mislead future workers about test coverage.
